Explore • Practice • Match • Master

Welcome, Photoshop Designer!

Learn the Photoshop toolbar, practice shortcuts, and prepare for your assessment.

Learning Target

I can identify Photoshop toolbar tools, explain what they do, and choose the correct tool for a design task.

1. Explore

Learn what each tool does and locate it in Photoshop.

2. Practice

Practice common keyboard shortcuts.

3. Match

Choose the best tool for real design tasks.

4. Assess

Complete the official Google Form assigned by your teacher.

Before You Begin

  1. Open Photoshop in another window.
  2. Keep this website open.
  3. Use a practice image.
  4. Experiment—mistakes are part of learning!
